description:
Images with agency='CMSA' (135 entries), 'USAF' (20 entries), 'SpaceIL' (11 entries), 'CFHT' (1 entry), and 'EHT' (1 entry) on the /credits page appear under the 'Wikimedia Commons contributors' section (or 'Solar System Scope' for 16 direct-other walker-fallback entries) instead of their correct agency-specific sections

Expected: Credits grouping routes each image to the section matching its owning agency/publisher, not its retrieval conduit. Agency-first grouping is the editorial rule documented in credits-grouping.ts ("upstream publisher wins over retrieval conduit"), and the existing agencies NASA/ESA/Roscosmos/CNSA/JAXA/ISRO/SpaceX etc. already follow it correctly — these five agency values are simply missing from the routing table.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every image-provenance entry with agency='CMSA' routes to credits section id 'cnsa' (China National Space Administration), not 'wikimedia-commons' or 'solar-system-scope' [reporter: "Group under the existing 'cnsa' section." (reporter follow-up Q&A)]
- Every image-provenance entry with agency='USAF' routes to credits section id 'us-space-force' (U.S. Space Force), not 'wikimedia-commons' [reporter: "Group under the existing 'us-space-force' section." (reporter follow-up Q&A)]
- Every image-provenance entry with agency='SpaceIL' routes to credits section id 'spaceil' (a section that does not yet exist — must be added), not 'wikimedia-commons' or 'solar-system-scope' [reporter: "Create a new source-logo entry for SpaceIL with section id 'spaceil'." (reporter follow-up Q&A)]
- The new 'spaceil' source-logo entry is added to static/data/source-logos.json with id='spaceil', and its section renders on /credits alongside other private-operator or space-agency sections [reporter: Derived from "Create a new source-logo entry for SpaceIL with section id 'spaceil'"; a section needs a source-logo row to render]
- The 14 CMSA entries with source_type='direct-other' (walker-fallback fleet-gallery entries for feitian, shenzhou-iva, taiyuan-lc-9, tiangong-2, zhurong that currently route to 'solar-system-scope') also route to 'cnsa' — same fix as the 121 wikimedia-commons CMSA entries, since the root cause is the missing agency mapping, not the source_type fallback [repo-data: static/data/image-provenance.json — verified 14 direct-other entries with agency='CMSA']

Domain facts:
- CMSA (China Manned Space Agency) is the human spaceflight arm of CNSA — the existing 'cnsa' source-logo section is the correct routing target for CMSA imagery
- USAF (United States Air Force) — the existing 'us-space-force' source-logo section covers US military space activity (Space Force absorbed USAF space functions); USAF is the correct routing target per reporter
- SpaceIL is the Israeli nonprofit behind the Beresheet lunar lander — no existing source-logo matches; a new entry with id='spaceil' is needed per reporter
- CFHT = Canada-France-Hawaii Telescope — not a space agency; per-image path is /images/fleet-galleries/smart-1/05.jpg (SMART-1 fleet entry gallery). Routing destination unknown.
- EHT = Event Horizon Telescope — per-image path is /images/science/black-holes-m87.jpg (science section, M87 black hole). Routing destination unknown.
- Affected entries: 121 CMSA (source_type=wikimedia-commons → currently routes to wikimedia-commons) + 14 CMSA (source_type=direct-other → currently routes to solar-system-scope) + 20 USAF (all wikimedia-commons) + 9 SpaceIL (wikimedia-commons) + 2 SpaceIL (direct-other) + 1 CFHT (wikimedia-commons) + 1 EHT (wikimedia-commons) = 168 entries need correct routing
- The bug is purely in the runtime routing function (src/lib/credits-grouping.ts, agencyToSourceId) — the provenance data already stores the correct agency values; no data change is needed
